title: GA Exporter — INFO Document Schema
description: Structured data extracted from a Grant Agreement (Preamble, Data Sheet, Annex 1 Part A) used to fill the INFO Word document and to feed the frontend preview.

coordinator.description: The 'coordinator' (COO) participant from the Data Sheet participants list.

ownEntity.description: The VILABS participant entry from the GA's own participants list, identified by the LLM itself — not supplied externally. VILABS legal form/country varies per grant (e.g. 'VILABS (CY) LTD', 'VILABS OE', a Bulgarian entity, etc.), so the prompt must scan the Preamble/Data Sheet §2 participants list for a legal or short name containing 'VILABS' (case-insensitive) and use that row. Drives the 'Contract' block and 'VIL Efforts' section.

ownEntityTotalPersonMonths.description: ownEntity's total person-months across the whole project. Source: the 'Total Person-Months' value for ownEntity's row in Annex 1 Part A's 'Staff effort per participant' table (a WP-by-participant matrix). 0 if ownEntity isn't a participant in this GA at all (see ownEntity), not if it simply has low effort — a genuinely low but nonzero value must be copied as-is, not rounded to 0.

callTopic.description: Concatenation of Call + Topic, e.g. 'HORIZON-EIE-2023-CONNECT-02 / HORIZON-EIE-2023-CONNECT-02-01'.

projectSummary.description: Verbatim or lightly trimmed project summary from the Data Sheet.

ownEffortSummary.description: One short free-text intro sentence for the 'VIL Efforts' section, e.g. 'VILABS leads WP4.' The detailed, renderable effort breakdown is the structured ownEntityTotalPersonMonths / workPackages[].ownEntityPersonMonths / workPackages[].tasks[].participants fields below, not this sentence — this is flavor text only, never the primary data source for rendering.

ownEntityPersonMonths.description: ownEntity's own person-months for this specific WP, read from its column/row in the same 'Staff effort per participant' matrix as ownEntityTotalPersonMonths. 0 if ownEntity has no effort recorded against this WP.

participants.description: Short names from this task's own 'Partners involved: ...' annotation in its Annex 1 Part A description (e.g. 'T1.1. ... | Leader: Sploro | Partners involved: ALL'). Copy verbatim: either the literal single-element list ["ALL"] when the text says 'ALL', or the exact short names listed (which may or may not include the leader again). Empty array only if this task's description truly has no 'Partners involved' annotation at all — do not default to just [leader].
